title: Autism Diagnoses Reached 32.2 Per Thousand Children
hook: Autism diagnoses reached 32.2 per thousand children.
closing: Better screening finds overlooked children, so diagnosis rates measure visibility as well as prevalence.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism diagnoses reached 32.2 per thousand children. Screening now identifies many more children who previously went unnoticed.
Boys reached 49.2 diagnoses per thousand children. Girls remain identified far less often.
California reached 52.6 diagnoses per thousand children. Where children live still changes who gets identified.
